page.title: Pricing analytics
page.desc: How the pricing loop is performing — every metric derivable from the audit trail and catalog.

kpi.acceptanceDef: Share of decided recommendations that were approved or adjusted.
kpi.priceIndexDef: Mean of our price ÷ competitor average across in-scope SKUs. 100 = at market.
kpi.leakageDef: Projected margin impact of recommendations that were rejected or expired undecided.
kpi.latencyDef: Mean time from recommendation creation to a recorded decision.
